title: skills(pm-dispatch): 强制条款② mandates CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER for IMPLEMENTATION of clause-② cards — drop it to TIER_DEFAULT and let the existing contract review be the gate (maintainer-authorised trial already running)
body:
Filed by the **`domain:spec` @ objectui seat** (`session_01Jmxdo7bmeqCQHLSfmLVX9w`, `os-warren`) on the maintainer's direct instruction. ⛔ Filed unassigned, not claiming — `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` is the `domain:skills` lane's governed surface and this seat ⛔ neither owns it nor edits it.

⛔ Routing input only, ⛔ not a lane assignment: this plainly lands in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, which the domain table puts in `domain:skills`. Grading and `domain:*` are the triage seat's.

## The maintainer instruction

Asked whether a fable review makes a fable *build* unnecessary, then, verbatim: **「开skill卡，在裁决落地之前,你直接按新规则试行。」**

⇒ Two things, and they are separable: (1) this card, to change the text properly through a governed PR; (2) a **trial already in force** in the `domain:spec` @ objectui lane, recorded on that seat post. ⚠️ The trial is the maintainer's authorisation, ⛔ not this card being pre-approved, and ⛔ not a licence for any other seat to deviate from the text as written.

## What the text says today

`SKILL.md`, 〈派发〉:

> 强制条款②:凡放宽接受集或扩大公开面的卡一律契约复审档;拉回已声明契约按常规档。

⇒ A clause-② card is built **and** reviewed at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. The proposal is to keep the review there and drop the **build** to `TIER_DEFAULT`.

## ⭐ Why this is a narrowing of an inconsistency, not a new idea

**① The architecture already declares review to be the compensation for low-tier dispatch.** `references/contract-review.md`, 降档保险丝:

> 契约复核 ⛔ 不适用额度耗尽豁免降档:豁免对象是**派发**,**复核正为补偿低档派发而存在**。

That sentence only makes sense if low-tier dispatch + high-tier review is an anticipated, sanctioned shape. 强制条款② is the one place that shape is forbidden.

**② The same trade is already ruled, by the maintainer, for another surface class.** `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, recording the 2026-08-20 ruling verbatim 「接受你的建议 — **fable 当审计师用,不当施工队用**」:

> references-only surfaces carry NO path mandate any more (**opus execution, compensated by the skill-face review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`**)

And `SKILL.md` already carries the mechanism with a name — 「降档施工的补偿控制 = 复核席跑契约复审档」 — scoped to references-only and one-line mechanical governed edits. ⇒ This card asks whether that scope should include clause ②.

**③ The cost asymmetry is measured, not assumed.** From this seat's round R1, two devs on comparable-sized cards:

| dev | tier | subagent tokens | tool uses |
|---|---|--:|--:|
| objectui#8583 | `claude-fable-5-1` | **335,280** | 89 |
| objectui#8327 | `opus` | **329,951** | 121 |

⇒ **Tier barely moves token COUNT (1.6% apart).** It moves unit price. The contract review that gated the first of those cost **211,330** tokens — so build is the large line item and review is the small one, and 强制条款② puts the expensive tier on the large one.

## ⚠️ The counter-evidence, stated first rather than buried

**The fable-built PR in that very round FAILED its contract review** (objectui#8583 / PR #8601, verdict at objectui#8583 comment `5587871554`). The build graded a public-surface widening as a `patch` changeset; it should be `minor`. The reviewer found it by checking the build's cited precedent against four counter-precedents.

That cuts **both** ways and an honest card has to say so:

- **For the change:** building at the ceiling did **not** prevent the error. The review caught it. That is precisely the claim this card rests on — the gate is the review.
- **Against the change:** it is one observation of a fable build erring, ⛔ not a measurement that an opus build errs no more often. ⚠️ **Nobody has measured the thing that actually matters: does the review FAIL rate rise when the build tier drops?** ⛔ Do not let this card be adopted as though that were known.

⚠️ And the round's own evidence is **not a clean comparison** and ⛔ must not be quoted as one: the opus card (objectui#8327) was `Clause-②: no`, a census/classification task of a different shape from the fable card's declaration widening. Two cards, two task shapes, ⇒ proves nothing about tier and quality. ⛔ Do not carry "the opus dev did the better work" forward as evidence; it is true of that round and does not generalise.

## Proposed change

**In `SKILL.md`, 强制条款②** — the accept-set/public-surface half moves from build-tier mandate to review-tier mandate:

- clause-② cards are **built** at `TIER_DEFAULT`;
- clause-② cards are **reviewed** at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, unchanged, and the carrier discipline (`needs:contract-review` on card and PR, cleared only by a posted verdict whose own `Scope-covered:` line covers the whole change) is unchanged;
- 强制条款① (protocol-semantic surfaces: this `SKILL.md`, the decision-frame copy, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`) is **untouched** — that is a different mandate with a different rationale, and ⛔ this card does not widen into it;
- the tier-fuse rule is untouched: a seat below `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` ⛔ still never clears a carrier itself.

⚠️ **`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`**: this file's line count only ever goes down. ⇒ the edit must pay for itself by deletion, and ⛔ re-wrapping does not count as paying. Plausibly this is net-negative anyway — it collapses a special case into the general 降档施工/补偿控制 rule that already exists.

## The tripwire this needs, and why it is the load-bearing half

⛔ **Do not land this as a permanent rule with no instrument.** Adopt it with a measurement:

> **Record the contract-review FAIL rate on clause-② cards built at `TIER_DEFAULT`.** Low ⇒ the trade holds. Materially higher than the fable-built baseline ⇒ the review does not in fact catch what a lower-tier build gets wrong, and the rule reverts.

⚠️ The baseline is currently **1 FAIL out of 1** fable-built clause-② card (this round) — ⛔ a sample of one, useless as a baseline, and named here so nobody treats it as one. The instrument matters more than the initial reading; whoever takes this card should say where the counter lives (round reports already carry a 复审清单专节, which is the obvious home).

## Executable acceptance criterion

`SKILL.md` states that a clause-② card is built at `TIER_DEFAULT` and reviewed at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` passes (line count not increased); `check:skill-frame-sync` / `-freshness` pass; and the round-report section that carries contract-review outcomes names the FAIL-rate counter.

## Governed-surface note

`.claude/skills/**` is a governed surface ⇒ terminal four-piece treatment: ⛔ no seat approves or merges it, the PR gets `needs-user-decision` plus a 「维护者速读」 comment, and review is requested from both authorised accounts. ⚠️ And `SKILL.md` is itself a **强制条款① surface**, so the PR that changes it is built at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` regardless of what it says about clause ② — the change ⛔ cannot exempt its own landing.

Refs: the 2026-08-20 ruling recorded in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (`MANDATORY_TIER_GLOBS` docblock) · `references/contract-review.md` 降档保险丝 · objectstack-ai/objectui#8583 and its verdict `5587871554` (the measured FAIL) · objectstack-ai/objectui#8327 (the opus-built card) · objectstack-ai/objectui#5734 (the seat post carrying the trial)
